newsitem.title: UK: Ashtead says five month turnover up 72 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ashtead says five month turnover up 72 pct.

text.p: Ashtead Group Plc said on Monday that turnover in the first five months of its financial year had risen 72 percent.
"Of this, 31 percent was from organic growth," chairman Peter Lewis told the company's annual general meeting.
He added that Ashtead was confident of another year of "significant progress".

Ashtead, which hires out plant machinery, announced in July that turnover for the year to April 30 had risen to 95.9 million stg from 67.3 million. Pre-tax exceptional profits were 18.3 million compared with 13.6.
Half year profits for the period to October 31, 1995 showed turnover of 43.1 million from 31.9 million with pre-tax profits of 8.7 million against 6.6 million.
